create_debug_visualizer: create a DebugVisualizer instance from a Habitat Simulator to render debug RGB observations
peek_object: use DebugVisualizer peek to generate a debug observation image centered on a physics object or bounding box
stitch_image_matrix: stitch a list of PIL images together into a single matrix image with configurable columns
project_point: project a 3D global point into a camera sensor's 2D screen space pixel coordinates
make_debug_video: produce and save a video from a cache of DebugObservation frames at a specified framerate
